blocks.text: Student Learning Outcomes (is unit mein kya seekhenge)
Is unit ke aakhir tak aap yeh kar sakenge:

items: Computing systems mein basic legal (qanooni) aur ethical (sahi-ghalat wale) pehlu samajh sakenge.
Digital duniya mein privacy (zaati maloomat ki hifazat) aur security ke alag alag threats (khatre) pehchan sakenge.
Security threats ko rokne aur unka nuqsan kam karne (mitigating) ki strategies (tareeqe) samjha sakenge.
Digital divide (technology tak pahunch ka farq) aur alag alag groups of society par iska asar par baat kar sakenge.
Computing systems mein bias (ek taraf jhukao) pehchan kar use khatam kar sakenge.
Information (maloomat) ko mehfooz aur zimmedari se istemal kar sakenge.
Logon aur society (muashra) par computing ke asar ko check kar sakenge.
Digital citizenship (internet par achha shehri hona) aur ethical conduct (achha aur sahi rawayya) ke principles apna sakenge.

blocks.text: Aaj ki digital duniya mein computing systems hamari zindagi ke har hisse mein bohat ahem kaam karte hain, apne phone aur laptop se le kar bare networks tak. Jab yeh systems hamari rozana zindagi ka hissa bante ja rahe hain, to in ke istemal se jure legal (qanooni) aur ethical (akhlaqi, yaani sahi aur ghalat ke) pehlu samajhna zaroori hai. Yeh chapter digital technology ke kai pehlu batata hai: terms of use, privacy aur security ke khatre, aur digital divide. Computing ke legal aur ethical masle (problems) mein data protection (data ki hifazat), intellectual property rights (kisi ki banai hui cheez par us ka haq) aur compliance with laws (in kaamon se jure qanoon maanna) shamil hain. Ethical pehlu privacy, fairness (insaf) aur society (muashra, yaani hum sab log) par technology ke bare asar ke bare mein hain.

“Terms of Use” ko Terms and Conditions ya Terms of Service bhi kehte hain. Yeh legal agreements (qanooni samjhaute) hain jo batate hain ke koi service ya product kaise istemal kiya ja sakta hai. Yeh terms provider (jaise website, app ya software company) banata hai aur user ko inhein maanna (agree karna) parta hai. Maqsad yeh hai ke provider aur user ka rishta fair (insaf wala) aur transparent (saaf aur khula) ho, aur dono apne rights (haq) aur obligations (zimmedariyan) samjhein.

Misalein: Jab aap Gmail jaisi email service par sign up karte hain to aap ko Google ki Terms of Use maanni parti hain. Yeh batati hain ke aap apna email account kaise istemal kar sakte hain, kis qism ka content share karna mana hai, aur Google aap ka personal data kaise sambhalta hai. Isi tarah Daraz jaisa Pakistani online shopping platform istemal karte waqt us ki Terms of Use mein payment ke tareeqon, return policy (cheez wapas karne ke rules) aur delivery ke tareeqe ki clauses (shartein) ho sakti hain, ta ke customer ko pata ho ke use kya milega aur us se kya umeed ki jati hai (yaani us ki kya zimmedari hai).

blocks.prompt: Terms of Use kaun banata hai aur kaun maanta hai?
blocks.explanation: Service ka provider (website, app ya software company) banata hai; service istemal karne ke liye user ko inhein maanna (agree karna) parta hai.

items: Computing ke legal aur ethical pehlu: data protection, intellectual property, qanoon maanna, privacy aur fairness (insaf).
Terms of Use = Terms and Conditions = Terms of Service: provider ke banaye legal agreements jo user maanta hai (Gmail, Daraz).
